title: Bare Crops (Croptopia x Bare Bones
description: A retexture of Croptopia's textures to fit with Bare Bones. (Croptopia's Choclaterie add-on compatible too!)
body:
## Croptopia, Simplified

Live your life with amazing food, now compatible with Bare Bones' comfortable aesthetic.

## Instructions

This pack requires the Bare Bones resource pack, and Croptopia mod. It's highly recommended to have the Croptopia Chocolaterie add-on. The official mod is here, but an unnofficial port to 1.20 is here. 

This pack has Bare Bone textures for both Croptopia, and the Chocolaterie addon!

## Contact

You can find me in the Bare Bones Discord Server. 

Username: venenoir

Display Name: Rosie

I have a [Google Issue Form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSexYWUHry04VcV9PAKD4-wxOazOoZSYTFQ6iMBtzwY4z45nSw/viewform?usp=dialog) for criticism and issue reports! Please feel free to leave constructive criticism and report issues here!
